filtersOrSort: client-side status filter: all|uploaded|proofs|favourites|finals; status derived: finalsReveal -> finals, hearts.length -> favourites, proofsReveal -> proofs, else uploaded
reads.pagination: none (all shoots; shoots can hold 1240 files each)

payload.name: files
payload.type: File[] image/* only, many, with progress {done,total,bytes,totalBytes}

special.uploads: many large images (a shoot up to ~1240 files, ~22MB each) with byte progress; a failed upload keeps the created shoot and can retry
special.pagination: none; reloads on vault change event

uiStatesHandled.note: today resolves from localStorage in a microtask, barely perceptible; becomes real with a network
listShoots/getStorage never throw (no online() call, no network); code is dead today

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: uploadFiles/createShoot throws: offline, full (device quota), failed
uiStatesHandled.note: 'full' is a localStorage quota today; maps to a server storage-limit error later

stubsObserved.evidence: live.set(id, URL.createObjectURL(f)); preview() makes a 240px jpeg data URL for at most PREVIEWS=240 files; the full file is never kept; header says 'Until it exists, the implementation keeps the shoot records on this device'
stubsObserved.standsInFor: upload of the original file to storage, and a served file url
stubsObserved.consequence: An uploaded shoot has no real file anywhere; after reload only small previews (some none) exist; finals download and reveal playback have no real bytes (STUB-12)

stubsObserved.evidence: storageOf computes used/peak/over/blocks/cost on the client from localStorage, VAULT price constants and PLANS[plan].vault from lib/pro-data.ts
stubsObserved.standsInFor: server-side storage metering and billing (peak of the month, blocks, price)
stubsObserved.consequence: Bill and allowance are whatever the browser computes; prices (VAULT {block:100, price:3000, bulkFrom:1000, bulkPrice:2500} naira, PLANS vault GB 100/500/20, packDays 90) are hardcoded, not read from config

stubsObserved.evidence: samplesOn() true when fw-account.wishes has an id starting 's-'; sampleShoots() builds six hardcoded shoots (ids sample-*, clients Adaeze and Tobi, The Okafor family, Ruth and Daniel, Zainab Musa, Kemi Adebayo, Chioma Eze) with /img/aisha-N.webp urls
stubsObserved.consequence: Sample rows are merged into every read path while on; a human cannot tell them from real rows
'offline' is the only network error; with no network calls, failures never occur otherwise (full is a localStorage quota error)
openedAt comes from a field in the browser's own store

stubsObserved.evidence: footer note: bytes > freeBytes ? 'Past {included} GB: {naira(VAULT.price)} a month per {VAULT.block} GB'
stubsObserved.consequence: Price shown comes from a client constant (3000 naira per 100 GB)
